label: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3200-48GT4XS-P-V2
description: Ruijie Reyee RG-NBS3200-48GT4XS-P-V2 - 52-port Layer 2+ managed PoE switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 all PoE/PoE+ (IEEE 802.3af/at) on a 370 W budget and 4x 10GE SFP+ uplinks. 176 Gbps switching capacity, 132 Mpps, two PWM fans with intelligent speed adjustment, 46 W with no PoE load and 450 W at a full PoE load.

poe.note: Datasheet: "PoE Out standard PoE/PoE+ (IEEE 802.3af/at)", "Number of PoE Out ports 48", "PoE budget 370 W". The vendor product page states "Max. 30 W on Each Port".

fabric.note: Datasheet "Switching capacity" 176 Gbps, "Forwarding rate" 132 Mpps (the hero block agrees).

notes: Datasheet: 48 RJ45 all PoE+, 4 x 10GE SFP+, "Maximum power consumption 46 W (with no PoE load) / 450 W (with full PoE load)", "RAM 512 MB", "Flash memory 256 MB", "Fan 2 x fixed fans", "Fan speed adjustment Intelligent speed adjustment", 440 x 300.6 x 44 mm, 4.32 kg, acoustic 30 dB at half PoE load / 48 dB at full PoE load. The V2 is a shallower chassis than the -P: 300.6 mm and 4.32 kg against 357.6 mm and 5.4 kg. Management is web/cloud only: the datasheet lists SSH "No", HTTP login "Yes", HTTPS login "Yes", eWeb, SNMPv1/v2c/v3 and Ruijie Cloud / Reyee App; there is no console port and no serial CLI in the datasheet, so no cli capability and no console interface. Layer 2+ software: "IEEE 802.1Q VLAN Yes", "LACP Yes", "STP/RSTP/MSTP Yes", "DHCP client Yes", "DHCP relay Yes", "DHCP server No", "IPv4 static route Yes", "IPv6 static route Yes" - static routes and relay, no dynamic routing protocol is listed. Port names ge1..geN / sfp1..sfpN / sfp+1..sfp+4 are the catalogue naming convention for a web-managed access switch; the datasheet states port counts, not names.
